title: Priority staging lanes for catalog sponsorship and eval triggers
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Problem: Enterprise customers submitting new model variants or pin requests lack predictable priority and visibility. Requests often sit in a single queue and require ad-hoc PM/SE triage, slowing onboarding and increasing SLA friction. Goal: Define deterministic 'staging lanes' in the intake flow that automatically classify requests by sponsorship level, risk band, and required eval gates; enable programmatic routing (fast-path / staged-canary / full-eval) and surface clear SLAs to customers. Success criteria: (1) 60% reduction in time-to-first-contact for sponsored enterprise requests, (2) clearly codified routing rules that reduce manual PM triage by 40%, (3) operational dashboards for lane health and blocked reasons.
acceptance_criteria: Intake form enhancements capture sponsorship, customer SLA tier, and backward-compatibility risk flags
Automatic assignment to lanes: Fast-path (sponsored low-risk), Staged-canary (medium risk), Full-eval (high risk)
Lane-level SLAs surfaced in console and in internal triage board
Eval triggers configured per lane: lightweight smoke tests for fast-path, 50k-sample evals for full-eval
Playbook documented for manual override and rollback; links to artifacts available
Dashboard shows median time-to-first-contact, lane volume, and blocked reasons within 24h
outcome: Create a deterministic prioritization layer for model catalog intake that aligns with enterprise contracts and reduces manual triage overhead. Provide hooks for engineering to implement routing rules and for SRE/Observability to expose lane health metrics.
risks: Over-automating could misclassify nuanced regulatory requests
Fast-path may allow an incompatible model variant to reach production without sufficient regression coverage
Need for engineering effort to surface new intake fields and wire routing to the orchestration layer
open_questions: What minimum eval criteria are acceptable for fast-path for enterprise customers with paid SLAs?
Should we allow customer-requested bypass (sponsor override) and what guardrails are required?
How do we represent partial approvals (pin only in staging) in the catalog UI and routing metadata?
